newsitem.title: DUBAI: ADNOC cuts July official crude prices 5-15 cents.
newsitem.headline: ADNOC cuts July official crude prices 5-15 cents.

text.p: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) has cuts its July official crude selling prices by 5-15 cents a barrel, ADNOC said on Monday.
Murban and Lower Zakum grades are cut 15 cents to $18.20 a barrel and Umm Shaif is down 15 cents to $17.95.
Upper Zakum is reduced by five cents to $17.30 a barrel.
ADNOC announces retroactive crude prices each month based on spot market developments.
